The only checkpoint passed is the one regarding printed patterns/colors on variants, which aligns with the graphics on the box. artifact_review: The Router correctly identified severe text gibberish (severity 4) and melted graphic shapes (severity 3). I agree with these assessments. Additionally, the overall image suffers from significant low-resolution blur and compression artifacts that degrade the entire scene, not just specific elements. The structural collapse noted by the Router on the green panel is also valid. The severity ratings are appropriate given the complete illegibility of the branding.
